name: @octopus-reef/adapter-runtime
description: Drops octopus-runtime in as Reef's authorization gate. The engine's Authorizer/Principal ports are structurally identical to octopus-runtime's, so a real RBAC/OIDC authorizer governs a session with the engine still offline — this package is where that dependency lives.
author: Ran Tao <ran@octopusos.ai>
